question: Baking powder is a mixture of:
solution:
The correct answer is **__Option - 2__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **Baking Powder** is a mixture of a **carbonate or bicarbonate and a weak acid (edible ).**
 
• Baking powder is used to increase the volume and lighten the texture of baked goods.
 
• It works by releasing** CO₂ gas** into a batter or dough through an Acid-Base Reaction causing bubbles in the wet mixture to expand.
